summary.text: Katrina Smith is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 62 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She works as a real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Katrina Smith was born in Rockland, Maine, and lives in Palermo, Maine.
She earned a B.A. in sociology from Gordon College in 1995, and her career has included work as a real estate broker, an investor, and in the education and banking industries.
Ballotpedia shows she lost the 2020 general election for Maine House District 96; she won District 62 in 2022, succeeding Gina Melaragno, and again in 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Ethics Committee and the Rules and Business of the House Committee.
